name: output-shaper-large-output
description: Three Bash calls: 23,892 characters (seq 1 5000, its last newline dropped) (over the 20,000 threshold, under Claude Code's 30,000 inline limit: the mod saves it), 168,894 characters (Claude Code saves it; the mod reuses that file), and 50 lines (left alone).

sessions.name: big, bigger, small
sessions.prompt: Run exactly these three shell commands with the Bash tool, each as its own separate Bash call, in this order, with nothing added to them: `seq 1 5000`, then `seq 1 30000`, then `seq 1 50`. Do not read any files. After the third, reply with one short line.

assert.label: 5,000-line output shaped: head, marker with counts
assert.matches:
^1
2
3
[\s\S]*\[output-shaper: lines 41 to 4,940 \(4,900 lines\) left out here; 5,000 lines, 23,892 characters in all\]
4941

assert.label: 5,000-line output: path is the mod's own saved file
assert.matches: \n5000\n\[output-shaper: the whole output is in {{repo}}/\.claude/output-shaper/[^/]+/toolu_\w+\.txt\. To see more, Grep

assert.label: 30,000-line output shaped in place of Claude Code's preview
assert.matches: \[output-shaper: lines 41 to 29,940 \(29,900 lines\) left out here; 30,000 lines, [\d,]+ (characters|bytes) in all\]

assert.label: 30,000-line output: path is Claude Code's tool-results file
assert.matches: \n30000\n\[output-shaper: the whole output is in \S+/tool-results/\S+\. To see more

assert.label: the mod saved exactly one output file
saved file holds the whole output
